weather.summary: Warm and sunny across the race weekend, with temperatures around 30°C and minimal rain risk.

commandBrief.label: GRID RECOVERY
commandBrief.title: Antonelli starts the weekend under recovery pressure
commandBrief.text: Underlying pace and traffic-clearing ability matter more than qualifying position alone because the championship leader is expected to start from the rear.

commandBrief.label: TECHNICAL WATCH
commandBrief.title: McLaren’s H-Wing gets its Monza test
commandBrief.text: The low-drag concept will be judged on whether McLaren can keep recent cornering strength while improving straight-line efficiency.

commandBrief.label: HOME RACE
commandBrief.title: Ferrari’s Monza package faces immediate scrutiny
commandBrief.text: Power deployment and aerodynamic efficiency will show whether the home-race development materially moves Ferrari toward the front.
